node.title: PMA stage 2: few-petal regime is CLASSICAL — Johnson/GS list bound applies
node.statement: Whenever N^2 > d |T| (T = union of petals, |T| = M(sigma+1)), i.e. petal count M below ~(d+sigma)^2/(d(sigma+1)), the per-D auxiliary list is poly by Guruswami-Sudan — an unconditional classical import (forward direction; bridge-ledger row).
